description: Roads and tracks is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing, and Regional and Rural Development. Queensland Roads and Tracks (QRT) Open Data Service. This includes State Controlled Roads, Local Government Controlled Roads, Local Roads of Regional Significance, Private Roads, Tracks and driveable beaches. This dataset contains segments of a road between nodes, intersections or road features, represented by a line between two vertices. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Assets, Building and Equipment. Its keywords are roads, tracks, spatial. The portal shows 562,744 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
